name: exploded-grinder-gpt-6-luna-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a manual coffee grinder, as an SVG. Use a hand grinder with conical burrs rather than flat burrs.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1500" height="1100" viewBox="0 0 1500 1100">

 <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2=".8"><stop stop-color="#d89a58"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#a96031"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#754126"/></linearGradient>

 <pattern id="hatch" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(35)"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="8" stroke="#d9e1d8" stroke-width="2" opacity=".5"/></pattern>
 <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feDropShadow dx="0" dy="6" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#172c2b" flood-opacity=".13"/></filter>
 <style>
  .ink{stroke:#243b3c;stroke-width:3;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}.fine{stroke:#33494a;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}.label{font:600 18px 'Arial',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.1px;fill:#243b3c}.small{font:14px 'Arial',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.7px;fill:#667572}.num{font:700 14px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#f7f3e9}.leader{fill:none;stroke:#607471;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.dim{fill:none;stroke:#a2aaa0;stroke-width:1.3;stroke-dasharray:5 7}
 </style>
</defs>

<text x="72" y="54" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="3" fill="#52716a">FIELD NOTES / BREW EQUIPMENT</text>
<text x="72" y="122" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="43" fill="#203a39">Hand grinder — exploded assembly</text>
<text x="74" y="153" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="16" letter-spacing=".8" fill="#667572">CONICAL BURR MECHANISM  ·  AXIAL ALIGNMENT  ·  NOT TO SCALE</text>
<rect x="1182" y="85" width="250" height="54" rx="4" fill="#e5e5d9"/>
